messages:
Samira: Quick flash from me today — short cadence update and 3 asks. TL;DR: Hosted growth +12% WoW, Dedicated pipeline healthy, Private beta on track for GA next month, one P1 incident last week summary + new policy ask :tada:

Samira: Wins — hosted usage growth from search and small-SaaS integrations. Cost per 1M tokens down ~6% after batching changes. Big shoutout to infra + runtime teams.

Priya: Huge props to the runtime crew — continuous batching tweak rolled Friday cut median tail latency by ~110ms. Not all regions yet but cherry-picked for mobile-heavy routes. :rocket:

Jenna: Ops note — incident on Tue 03/09: a routing misconfig caused ~15m throttling for Dedicated customers in eu-west. No data lost. Postmortem in #postmortems later today.

Alex: Postmortem highlights — root cause: a rate-limiter rule misapplied during a canary. Mitigations: (1) automated rule lint in CI, (2) canary run with synthetic load, (3) dashboard alerts tuned. I'll post links to the runbook.

Samira: Action items from me — please prioritize: 1) ship the CI lint for rate-limiter by EOW (owner: Alex), 2) finalize Private GA checklist and org communication (owner: Marco), 3) approve a temporary increase in enterprise log retention for regulated customers (Jenna + legal).

Marco: Private GA status — main checklist: billing/quotas, KMS integration, console UX polish, and the compliance attestation. We need final product sign-off by next Tue to hit GA the week after. Working on pricing note for sales.

Priya: Engineering asks — lock down the quantization matrix for two top-requested models (we saw a perf/cost tradeoff on internal evals). Will surface recommended profiles by Thu.

Jenna: Policy ask — propose default enterprise log retention bumped to 180 days for the new compliance tier. This is opt-in. Need quick legal/infosec sign-off; otherwise default stays 90 days.

Samira: I'm OK with opt-in 180d for the compliance tier; legal to confirm. Also we should prepare 1-pager for customers explaining retention options and cost impact. (Owner: Product + Sales).

Priya: Quick infra note — we'll disable the risky rate-limiter rule template by default and require explicit opt-in for aggressive limits. That should avoid future P1s. Alex to PR the change.

Alex: deploy-bot: Canary deploy to us-east-1 completed at 2141598400. No regressions detected.

Alex: deploy-bot: Auto-rollback triggered in eu-west canary at 2141599900; rollback used `rollback --id=canary-2026-03-09 --safe=true`. Manual verification ok.

Samira: Metrics snapshot I care about next week: (a) 95th tail latency across hosted routes, (b) Dedicated commit pipeline conversion rate, (c) Private GA sign-offs. Please drop numbers in the exec dashboard by Mon EOD.

Marco: Will add conversion numbers and forecast to the exec dashboard.

Jenna: I'll own the compliance + legal thread and post a recommended policy language by tomorrow.

Samira: Last: remind your teams — no surprise rollouts on rate-limiter templates. Use canaries + synthetic load. We'll have a short mandatory sync for all ENG leads Wed 09:00 PT (30m).

Priya: +1. I'll schedule and include a quick checklist for canary tests.

Samira: Thanks all. Quick reactions if you saw this and own an item: react with :white_check_mark: or reply with ETA.

Marco: ✅ (Private GA sign-off target Tue)

Alex: ✅ (CI lint PR by EOW)

Jenna: ✅ (policy draft by tomorrow)

Samira: Great, closing the loop. Will follow up in next exec brief.
